description: Public-safe status definitions for official live broadcast and replay availability research.

statuses.label: Official free stream
statuses.definition: Live video is available from an official source without a paid TV package, betting account, or required wagering relationship.

statuses.label: Official account required
statuses.definition: Live video is available from an official source, but access requires a standard login or registration.

statuses.label: Betting account required
statuses.definition: Live video is described by an official or official-partner source as requiring a betting or wagering account.

statuses.label: Paid TV required
statuses.definition: Live video is available through an official broadcaster or rights-holder that requires a paid TV subscription or equivalent package.

statuses.label: Broadcast partner
statuses.definition: Live coverage is provided through a named official broadcast or streaming partner.

statuses.label: Replay available
statuses.definition: Race replay video or archived official coverage is available from an official or official-partner source.

statuses.label: Official social stream
statuses.definition: Live or replay coverage is published through a verified official social channel for the authority, venue, event, or rights-holder.

statuses.label: Racecourse-only viewing
statuses.definition: Official information indicates viewing is available at the venue, with no verified public online live stream.

statuses.label: Event-only coverage
statuses.definition: Coverage is available only for specific events, meetings, festivals, or limited race days rather than as regular jurisdiction-wide coverage.

statuses.label: Geographically restricted
statuses.definition: Official information indicates access is limited by country, region, territory, or rights market.

statuses.label: Not verified
statuses.definition: No sufficient official or clearly official-partner evidence has been confirmed yet.

statuses.label: No official source found
statuses.definition: Reasonable checks of official and official-partner sources found no public live or replay source.

statuses.label: Archive only
statuses.definition: Official source provides historical or archive video, but no verified current live coverage.

statuses.label: Unsafe unofficial source
statuses.definition: A source appears to be an unofficial mirror, repost, scraped stream, or unverified upload and must not be displayed as a usable viewing option.
